checks.details: Boundary, architecture, source-structure, workspace typecheck, unit tests and production build passed; app suite covered 317 files and 1698 tests.
Packaged Electron production application and verified distribution boundary and text WASM assets.
Preview, cancel, replace, undo and redo passed without page errors; first-edit recovery 78.85 ms, one configured face, 0.3 MiB loaded font bytes and 0.72 ms latest shaping.
Discovered 460 metadata-only faces, loaded only the selected 58,920-byte face, verified its fingerprint and authored live text through WASM/WebGPU without page errors.
Point, paragraph, transform, repeat and duplicate interactions completed without page errors.
All seven layer signatures, including point, paragraph, rotated and path text, survived PSD export and reopen as their original semantic types.
